display.purpose: Page titles, coupon and section titles, uppercase.

label.purpose: Field names, fare-box labels, nav and buttons.

figures.purpose: Every figure the user decides with.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Tickets, panels, menus and toasts resting on the desk.

motion.name: ease-issue
motion.purpose: Coupons and leaves being issued; stamps pressing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a screen: Start, Save changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:46px; padding:0 20px; border:1.5px solid #d7262d; border-radius:6px; background:#d7262d; color:#fff; font:700 17px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#b51d23; border-color:#b51d23; }

components.name: Fare Boxes
components.description: Hairline-ruled fields that explain the pick in figures.
components.css: .ds-fare { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); margin:0; border:1px solid #0d1b3d; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; } .ds-fare > div { padding:8px 12px; border-right:1px solid #0d1b3d; } .ds-fare > div:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-fare dt { font:700 12px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5b6782; } .ds-fare dd { margin:6px 0 0; font:700 17px/1.2 'Courier Prime', monospace; color:#4b2e83; }

components.name: Bar Tag
components.description: One-line baggage tag on the right of the navy top bar: weather or sync state.
components.css: .ds-tag { position:relative; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:8px; background:#e6dff1; color:#0d1b3d; } .ds-tag::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:-5px; top:50%; width:10px; height:10px; margin-top:-5px; border-radius:50%; background:#0d1b3d; } .ds-tag .l { display:block; font:700 12px/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#3b4866; } .ds-tag .v { display:block; font:700 15px/1.25 'Courier Prime', monospace; color:#4b2e83; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: VOID (jet red) or VALIDATED (carbon purple) pressed onto a coupon.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:6px 18px 2px; border:5px solid #d7262d; border-radius:8px; color:#d7262d; font:800 72px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; transform:rotate(-11deg); opacity:.92; }

narrative.overview: Your free time is a ticket. One coupon to use now, the rest of the book behind it, every state stamped on paper. Carrier navy, coupon white on stock white, jet red for the one action, carbon purple for every figure.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width best-pick coupon with a photo stub
Hairline fare boxes in carbon numerals
One Lucide icon family, no emoji

rules.name: One Red
rules.body: Jet red only on the primary action and the VOID stamp.

rules.name: Figures Are Purple
rules.body: Every number the user decides with is Courier Prime in carbon purple.

dos: Do use one Lucide icon family for every glyph.
Do give built-in ideas a bundled, credited photo.
Do keep 44px hit targets and a visible focus ring.
donts: Don't use emoji or unicode symbols as icons.
Don't use red for anything but the primary action and VOID.
Don't fall back to a grid of identical dark cards.
